value: SIFT framework: Stop → Investigate the source → Find better coverage → Trace claims. Primary sources > secondary. Peer-reviewed > blog. Government/academic > commercial. Check: author credentials, publication date, citations, conflicts of interest.

Collect 5-10 sources, identify claims that appear in 3+, note outliers, steelman strongest opposing argument, assign confidence level (High: multiple independent peer-reviewed sources / Medium: expert consensus / Low: single source).

Hypertrophy: 10-20 sets per muscle group per week, 6-20 rep range, progressive overload mandatory, 48h minimum recovery per muscle. Strength: 1-5 reps, 85-100% 1RM, longer rest (3-5 min). Don't mix goals in same session.

Protein: 1.6-2.2g per kg bodyweight for muscle gain/retention. Caloric surplus +200-500kcal for lean bulk. Deficit -300-500kcal for fat loss (max -750 to preserve muscle). Meal timing matters less than daily totals.

7-9h for most adults. Sleep debt is real and cumulative. Core principles: consistent wake time (most important), dark/cool room (65-68°F/18-20°C), no screens 1h before bed, no caffeine after 2pm. Naps < 20min to avoid grogginess.

Product-market fit signals: 40% of users would be 'very disappointed' without product (Sean Ellis test), NPS > 40, organic word-of-mouth > paid acquisition, retention curve flattens (doesn't go to zero), revenue compounds without proportional sales effort.
SaaS metrics: CAC payback < 12 months. LTV:CAC > 3:1. Gross margin > 70%. Net revenue retention > 100% (expansion revenue). Churn < 2%/month (consumer), < 1%/month (SMB), < 0.5%/month (enterprise).

Red flags in contracts: unlimited liability clauses, one-sided IP assignment, non-compete covering entire industry, automatic renewal without notice, jurisdiction in unfavourable location, no dispute resolution process, vague deliverable definitions.

Zero trust: never trust, always verify. Microsegmentation. Identity is the new perimeter. Least privilege access. Assume breach posture. Continuous validation of device and user health. Encrypt data in transit AND at rest.
